Built for the drop

Massive battlegrounds

Sprawling maps made for fights at every range, from rooftop sniping to close-quarters chaos.

Deep weapon arsenal

Loot dozens of weapons and tune them with attachments to match your role in the squad.

Shrinking storm zone

The safe zone closes fast. Rotate early, hold good ground, or force a fight before the storm does.

Fireteam tactics

Play solo, duo, squad or fireteam with pings, revives, and shared loadouts to keep the team in sync.

Ranked seasons

Climb the ladder each season for new rewards and cosmetics, with a leaderboard that resets the fight.

Advanced anti-cheat

A dedicated system monitors every match so skill, not exploits, decides who is left standing.
